The Challenge

Virtual Care is Growing — but Measuring Its Impact is Hard

68%

Of healthcare organizations lack standardized metrics to evaluate telehealth program performance, making it difficult to justify investment.

2x

Higher patient engagement is associated with better clinical outcomes, yet most providers cannot identify which patients are disengaging until it's too late.

45%

Of remote monitoring programs fail to achieve ROI because they lack real-time analytics to optimize protocols and patient selection.

Scale Virtual Care Intelligently

Telehealth and remote patient monitoring are transforming healthcare delivery, offering convenience, improved access, and cost savings. But without robust analytics, it's nearly impossible to know if your programs are delivering the expected clinical and financial returns.

Our Telehealth & Remote Monitoring Analytics service provides comprehensive metrics on utilization, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and financial performance. We help you identify which patients benefit most from virtual care, optimize program design, and demonstrate ROI to stakeholders.

We integrate data from telehealth platforms, remote monitoring devices, EHRs, and billing systems to give you a 360‑degree view of virtual care performance. Our dashboards provide real‑time visibility into program performance, enabling rapid adjustments and continuous improvement.

Expand your virtual care programs with confidence, knowing that every decision is backed by data.

Telehealth & RPM Analytics

Our Approach

Data Aggregation & Integration

We connect to your telehealth platforms, remote monitoring devices (wearables, BP cuffs, glucose monitors), EHR, and billing systems. We consolidate data from these disparate sources into a unified analytics layer, enabling comprehensive visibility into virtual care performance.

Engagement & Utilization Analytics

We track visit volume, patient activation, device adherence, and program participation. We identify patients who are engaged and those who are at risk of dropping out. We analyze utilization patterns by condition, demography, and referral source.

Clinical Outcome Measurement

We measure clinical improvements — changes in blood pressure, glucose levels, weight, symptom scores, and functional status. We link these outcomes to specific interventions and identify which programs yield the best results.

Cost & ROI Analysis

We quantify the financial impact of virtual care: reductions in ED visits, hospitalizations, length of stay, and total cost of care. We calculate ROI for each program, enabling you to prioritize investments and negotiate with payers.

Patient Segmentation & Personalization

We segment patients by clinical condition, risk level, digital literacy, and engagement patterns. We identify which patient cohorts benefit most from virtual care, allowing you to tailor programs and outreach strategies.

Program Optimization & Scaling

We recommend program adjustments — timing, frequency, communication channels, and device selection — to maximize engagement and outcomes. We help you scale successful programs and decommission underperforming ones.

What We Deliver

Program Performance Dashboard

Real-time visualization of key metrics — active patients, device adherence, visit volume, and clinical alerts — for each virtual care program.

Patient Engagement & Retention Report

Identify patients who are disengaging and predict dropout risk. Receive recommendations for re-engagement strategies.

Clinical Outcome Analysis

Quantify improvements in clinical metrics — BP, glucose, weight, symptom scores — and link them to specific interventions and patient cohorts.

Cost Savings & ROI Calculation

Measure avoided ED visits, hospitalizations, and reduced length of stay. Calculate ROI by program and patient segment.

Optimization Recommendations

Actionable insights to improve engagement, clinical outcomes, and financial performance — including protocol adjustments, device selection, and communication strategies.

Executive & Payer Reporting

Professional reports for leadership, payers, and investors demonstrating the value of your virtual care programs.

Core Capabilities

Real-Time Program Dashboard

View key metrics — active patients, device adherence, clinical alerts, and cost savings — in a single, interactive dashboard. Track performance over time and across programs.

Clinical Alert & Escalation

Identify patients with concerning readings and prioritize follow-up. Automate alerts to care teams for timely intervention, reducing adverse events.

Patient Engagement Score

Compute an engagement score for each patient based on device usage, response rates, and visit attendance. Identify disengaged patients for targeted outreach.

Cost Savings Calculator

Quantify savings from avoided ED visits, hospitalizations, and reduced readmissions. Visualize cumulative savings by program and patient cohort.

Device & Technology Performance

Track device reliability, data transmission delays, and patient-reported usability. Identify technology barriers and inform device selection.

ROI & Value Reporting

Generate reports for leadership, payers, and investors demonstrating the clinical and financial value of your virtual care programs.

Why Choose Us?

Higher Patient Engagement

Achieve better management of chronic conditions — hypertension, diabetes, CHF — with continuous monitoring and proactive care.

Significant Cost Reduction

Data-Driven Program Expansion

Competitive Advantage

Lead in virtual care innovation and attract patients, clinicians, and payers who value digital health services.

Patients appreciate the convenience and responsiveness of virtual care; providers benefit from reduced burnout and better continuity.
